advisory-1-title: GBSA-2026-0001 — HTML injection in document and spreadsheet editing
advisory-2-title: GBSA-2026-0002 — Arbitrary file read in the drive monitor
authoritative-note: Authoritative version: Portuguese (Brazil). If translations differ, this version prevails.
csaf-link: Open the CSAF 2.0 feed change index
detail-exploit-a: There is no evidence of active exploitation at the time of publication. New evidence updates the advisory and requires a new review.
detail-impact: Confidentiality and integrity: arbitrary scripts may run in other users' browsers. Versions 6.8.0 through 6.8.11 are affected; other platforms are not.
detail-remediation: Upgrade to version 6.8.12 or later. No validated workaround exists; upgrading is the only recommended measure.
detail-summary: An authenticated user can inject HTML into document and spreadsheet titles, affecting other participants in the collaboration session. Version 6.8.12 fixes the issue.
